title: HiddenWalkways
description:
The paths characters walk on that run over objects about to be hidden
(ADR 0051): hiding an object through Base Object Swapper takes away
what characters stand on, but not the paths they follow over it.

found.description: The objects asked about that were found there.

place.description:
The worldspace or interior cell asked about, as in
[`AreaObjects::world`].

walkways.description: Each version of a navigation mesh that runs over one of them.

ObjectRef.description:
A placed object, by the plugin that placed it first and its number in
that plugin. Unlike a form ID as the game shows it, this does not
depend on the load order.

localId.description: The object's number in that plugin.

Walkway.description:
One plugin's version of a navigation mesh that runs over a hidden
object.

cell.description:
Where the navigation mesh lies, for people: an interior cell's
internal name, or the worldspace and the cell's grid position.

navmesh.description:
The navigation mesh, by the plugin that first defined it and its
number there, such as `skyrim.esm:102F4F`.

plugin.description: The plugin of this version, as the load order spells it.

triangles.description: How many of its triangles lie on the object.

used.description:
Whether the game uses this version. A version another plugin
replaces does no harm.
